title: The Volcano
objectives_ko: 글자 V·W·X의 이름과 소리를 알고 말한다
V·W·X로 시작하는 단어 9개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다
사이트워드 look, at을 보고 읽는다 (X는 단어 끝에서 /ks/ 소리가 남을 안다)

panels.desc: A cozy little village corner inside the garden: a small house wall with a window with blue curtains and a flower pot on the sill, a stone water fountain, and a yellow taxi parked on the lane. In the middle of the lane a small volcano mound rumbles with little puffs of smoke, and a glowing golden seed sits on its rim. Hedgie points at the volcano nervously; Bun leans in curiously; Pip is trying to say a sound but its whole body buzzes like a bee, feathers vibrating with little motion lines. Hidden in the picture: the volcano, a blue knitted vest hanging on a washing line, the taxi. Grumble sits on a stack of boxes nearby with a pinecone stuck in each ear, arms crossed, eyes shut; his lantern beside him shines very bright, like a small star.

BOOM — the little volcano pops with a puff of orange lava sparks and everyone jumps into the air: Bun with her boots flying, Hedgie rolled into a ball, Pip upside down. The water fountain sprays a tall splash of clear water, and a pink earthworm has been tossed out of the ground and lands on the lane looking dizzy with a tiny bump on its head. Behind them the new V letter tree with vet-, vest- and volcano-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: the fountain water, the worm, the window with blue curtains. Grumble has fallen backwards off his boxes with both pinecones shooting out of his ears; his lantern rolls on the ground still shining very bright.

A veterinarian in a white coat kneels on the lane and gently wraps a tiny bandage around the pink worm, which lies on top of a brown cardboard box; six brown boxes are stacked beside the taxi. A glowing golden seed sits on the top box. Hedgie watches with his paws clasped; Bun holds up six fingers; Pip glows. Hidden in the picture: the vet, six red strawberries in a row on a box lid, the open box. Grumble does NOT appear.

The village lane with three new letter trees (V with vet, vest and volcano fruits; W with window, water and worm fruits; X with six-strawberries, box and taxi fruits). The bandaged worm waves happily from the fountain edge; the taxi driver honks and waves. Bun and Hedgie point at the trees; Pip glows on the taxi roof. Grumble stands in the middle of the lane without his pinecones, holding his lantern up with both paws and staring at it with wide eyes: it blazes bright like a little star and lights the whole lane. Hidden in the picture: the taxi, the worm.
